# blanks-around-lists

- ID: `MD032`
- Category: Lists
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `bullet`, `ul`, `ol`, `blank_lines`

Lists outside other lists have a blank or comment line above and below.

## Why

Some parsers, such as kramdown, do not recognize a list without the blank lines.

## Options

This rule has no options.

## Fix

The fix inserts the missing blank line, keeping any blockquote markers. gomdlint
may report a finding without a fix when the fix would change a line with one
character in brackets, such as \[x\] or \[1\], or the lines around it up to a
blank line, because it could add or remove a task list checkbox. In a document
with raw HTML other than comments and plain br, wbr, hr or img tags, gomdlint
reports every finding without a fix.

## Configure

Under `rules`, `blanks-around-lists: false` turns the rule off and
`blanks-around-lists: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable blanks-around-lists` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line blanks-around-lists -->
```
